notas: Implemented pure re-exports: `Slot`, `Slottable` and type `SlotProps` from `@radix-ui/react-slot`. No host, root marker or stylesheet; composing components expose `asChild`. Contract: [#103](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/103).

Implemented React primitive under [approved v0.1 contract](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/112#issuecomment-6251584644): screen-reader-only content with Radix-owned hiding geometry, required children, asChild and an HTMLElement ref to the actual HTML host. No stylesheet or appearance variants. Legacy hidden-content rules are unchanged.

Implemented in @egdev/ui: static Material v2 box with tones `surface-0…3`, `well` and `overlay` (solid reduced-transparency fallback), elevation 0–3 on raised tones, padding and radius presets, and `asChild`. Token-backed CVA, no stylesheet. Gauge keeps its own transparent native frame. Contract: [#106](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/106).

Implemented in @egdev/ui: Stack (vertical flow, no wrap) and Cluster (wrapping row) with exact spacing-token gaps and flex alignment. Contract: [#105](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/105).
Una primitiva tipográfica con variantes (`display`, `hero`, `section`, `eyebrow`, `show`, `inverse`).

Implemented passive span via Radix Separator with decorative default and horizontal/vertical orientation. Token-backed brand rule; no public children, ref or asChild. Legacy `.eg-rule` and `--vertical` remain unchanged. Contract: [#83](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/83).
Implemented in @egdev/ui: unpainted responsive media geometry using Radix AspectRatio. See issue #78; consumer compositions own media semantics and Material.

Implemented unstyled out-of-tree div with eg-portal, ready custom container and forwarded div ref. No focus, positioning, presence or z-index policy; Radix-specific components keep their own portals. Contract: issue #97 v0.1.

Implemented native form label via `@radix-ui/react-label`: `field`/`choice` typography, `eg-label`, native association and forwarded label ref. No stylesheet or `asChild`; future Field composes it. Contract: [#87](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/87).
Pierde `--icon` (pasa a IconButton). Mantiene `.eg-btn-split` como molécula ButtonGroup.

Provisional future icon-only action concept; not an implemented or importable React API. The previous reference was retired under the [Gauge v0.9 amendment](components/gauge/v0.9/composition-amendment.md); Gauge's current finish follows the [v0.10 amendment](components/gauge/v0.10/transparent-interior-amendment.md).
Botón conmutado (mostrar/ocultar capa, silenciar). IconButton `pressed` puede apoyarse en él.

Implemented in @egdev/ui: one inline glyph from the closed 42-name set (25 Foundation plus 17 Lucide additions, including check, minus and plus) with sm/md/lg presets, optional currentColor fill and an optional label through Radix AccessibleIcon; decorative by default. No stylesheet; legacy `.eg-icon*` rules are unchanged. Contract: [#58](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/58).
Control nativo; sale de Field. Variante `mono` para código y URLs.
Variantes `code` y `prose` (antes Field --code y --prose).
Select de Radix con el aspecto de Field.
Existía solo como clase.
Tamaño del anillo, umbrales, volumen.
Grupo de opciones exclusivas; base de SelectTile y de chips exclusivos.
Siempre interactivo (filtro o selección). Los grupos van en ChipGroup.
Etiqueta estática con `tone` (neutral, info, success, warning, danger, brand) e icono opcional; `solid`.
Preset de Badge en Mando (read, write, irreversible, blocked).
LiveDot pasa a `StatusDot state='live'` (con pulso y `--static`).

Implemented React atom under [approved v0.1 contract](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/60): one key or shortcut glyph as native inline kbd text with a flat hairline treatment (label-default recipe, secondary text). Optional label gives symbol keys a spoken name through Radix VisuallyHidden and hides the glyph. Combos are consumer composition. No stylesheet.
Radix Avatar da el fallback a iniciales mientras carga la imagen.
Letra o marca de producto con `gradient-btn-primary` + `shadow-btn-primary` (M, C, L, Cr, Mt, Q). Hoy está copiada a mano en cada app.
Recurso gráfico de la web; revisar si alguna app lo usa.
Radix Progress da `role=progressbar` y los aria-value*.

Currently implemented React component: one passive circular 0–100 measurement with optional decorative center and consumer-selected normal, warning, critical or muted state. Own transparent native frame uses existing tokens, not Surface. Effective contract: [v0.10 amendment](components/gauge/v0.10/transparent-interior-amendment.md), [v0.9 amendment](components/gauge/v0.9/composition-amendment.md) and [base](specs/gauge.md). Not task progress, multiple rings or a dock API; no Radix dependency.
Pierde `--glass` (usa Surface).

Approved six-row catalogue correction: Criterio application pattern, not a generic UI atom or molecule. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). Catalogue decision only; no implementation implied.
Input file nativo oculto con VisuallyHidden.
Hace falta para IconButton, ModuleRail y Gauge. No existe.

Implemented React atom under [approved v0.1 contract](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/69): indeterminate open-arc indicator at the Icon scale (sm/md/lg), inherited currentColor, one turn per second through the --animate-spin token and static under reduced motion. Optional label makes a polite status region with Radix VisuallyHidden text; without it the spinner is decorative. No stylesheet.

Implemented React primitive under the [approved v0.1 contract](https://github.com/egdev6/egdev-design-system/issues/102#issuecomment-6251558042) plus the approved v0.2 delta: decorative placeholder in line/block/circle silhouettes with token preset sizes, hidden semantics and host-owned loading/busy state. On-by-default decorative opacity pulse with reduced-motion always static; consumers may pass pulse={false}. No stylesheet or Radix base.
Pasa a molécula: etiqueta + control + ayuda + error + contador. El control es un átomo aparte.
Botón dividido (`--join-start/--join-end`) y grupos de botones.
Filtros (múltiple) y selección exclusiva (borde de la pantalla en Quorb).

Provisional future tab-selection concept; not an implemented or importable React API. The previous reference was retired under the [Gauge v0.9 amendment](components/gauge/v0.9/composition-amendment.md); Gauge's current finish follows the [v0.10 amendment](components/gauge/v0.10/transparent-interior-amendment.md).
Menú desplegable con items, separadores, `--danger` y submenús.
Navegación lateral con grupos plegables, contadores y etiquetas `__tag`.

Approved six-row catalogue correction: Menu composition recipe with an Avatar trigger; no standalone UserMenu export. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). Catalogue decision only; no implementation implied.
Panel flotante al hacer clic.
El panel de detalle de Quorb al pasar por un Gauge.
`role=status` o `alert`. Mantiene `--sm`.
Avisos efímeros (publicado, copiado). No existe.
Fila/tarjeta genérica con estados (`new`, `failed`, `done`, `empty`, `dragging`, `off`) y `--row`.
Composición de dominio en Cadencia sobre ListItem.
Proporciones como variantes (portrait, story, square, wide, banner).
`--chat` para el chat en vivo.
Eyebrow + título + acciones. Repetido a mano en todas las apps.
Cabecera de sección en registro Show; valorar unificar con PageHeader por `register`.
Etiqueta + valor + barra + ayuda (Quorb, egdev-live, Criterio).
`--error`, `--stopped`, `--wide`, `--banded` (cabecera y pie en banda tonal, Grafito); `--glass` pasa a Surface.

Approved six-row catalogue correction: one search-launch action with an optional shortcut hint; the consumer owns the palette and shortcut binding. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; no implementation implied.
Approved six-row catalogue correction: one framed-image concept; AspectRatio is a supporting primitive. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; no implementation implied.
Approved six-row catalogue correction: one quotation concept; Text is a supporting piece. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; no implementation implied.
Approved six-row catalogue correction: one time-remaining display concept; Text is a supporting piece. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; no implementation implied.
Ficha de perfil de la web. Barra en banda `surface-2` (Grafito).
Sube a ui si otra app aloja el agente.
Argumentos crudos en Collapsible.
Pie en banda `surface-0` (Grafito).
Valorar construirlo sobre ListItem.
Cabecera en banda `surface-2` (Grafito).
Sale de TipsSlider: contador, anterior/siguiente, arrastre y teclado.

Coordinates dialog content and actions as one reusable overlay interaction, not a structural page region. Retains the `sheet` variant for side panels (MobileMenu). See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation approval.

Coordinates a confirmation prompt and decision actions as one reusable interaction, not a structural page region. Retains destructive confirmations (delete, disconnect). See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation approval.

Coordinates search input, results and command activation as one reusable interaction, not application-level structure. Radix has no combobox; cmdk over Radix Dialog remains a candidate requiring confirmation. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation or dependency approval.
La barra lateral de todas las apps.
Raíl compacto de Mando; genérico.
Navegación inferior móvil.

Coordinates tabular data and local sorting and selection as one reusable unit, not a structural page region. Retains the native table with sorting and selection in the hook. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation approval.
`.eg-day` y `.eg-post-row` pasan a partes internas. Falta vista Mes.
Vista previa a tamaño fijo con zonas seguras.
La tira es un `role=toolbar` con foco itinerante; Radix Toolbar lo da hecho.

Web composition recipe arranging ProjectCard instances; no independently specified component API or behavior beyond that composition. Not a standalone component or export. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). Catalogue classification only, no implementation approval.
El carrusel genérico sube a ui.

One decorative particle-background effect rendered with canvas; it does not coordinate independent UI concepts or define a structural region. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation approval.

One rendered brand-mark effect using three.js with an SVG fallback; rendering complexity does not make it a structural region or coordinate independent UI concepts. See [classification rules](CATALOGACION.md). API unchanged; catalogue classification only, no implementation or dependency approval.
Barra lateral + contenido; móvil con TabBar. Hoy se repite en las seis apps.
`--pro`, `--show`, `--flood`, `--deep`; `--grafito` (+ `--fade-top`, `--fade-bottom`) para lectura sobre gris.
